posts.title: Memory-enforced GPU sharing in Kubernetes with CUDA 13.4
posts.summary: NVIDIA describes GPU sharing in Kubernetes with enforced memory limits per workload. This lets fractional-GPU workloads share a device without MIG's hardware partitioning, and a runaway workload can't take memory from its neighbors.

posts.title: Three ways to speed up MoE inference on NVIDIA DGX Spark
posts.summary: Profiling Ling-3.0-flash at batch size 1 on DGX Spark shows decoding is memory-bound, because reading the weights dominates runtime. The post covers optimizations for the MoE computation and the other operations that stood out in the profile.

posts.title: TLA-Verus: LLM agents prove temporal properties of TLA+ specs
posts.summary: A NeurIPS'26 workshop paper translates TLA+ specs from GitHub into Verus. LLM agents then try to prove the safety and liveness properties. Murat Demirbas reviews the approach and its limits.

posts.title: Dell adds quantum-safe FC encryption to PowerStore and identity recovery to PowerProtect
posts.summary: The November PowerStore release adds quantum-safe encryption of Fibre Channel data in flight when paired with supported PowerEdge servers. PowerProtect gains identity-system recovery and hardening for AI factories.
